cues.en: integrated mouse, either. Thank goodness this thing actually has some ports you can plug in!

cues.zh: 能用上正经的键盘、鼠标和显示器，这确实是它的一大救星，尽管牺牲了
cues.en: Being able to use a proper keyboard, mouse, and monitor is truly its saving grace, despite killing

cues.zh: 便携性。存储方面依然是一个 CF 接口，出厂就配了张 2G 的卡。
cues.en: portability. For storage there’s a CF interface once again, packing a 2 gig card from the get-go.

cues.zh: 它启动用的是 90 年代中期的 American Megatrends BIOS，配的操作系统也与之相称：
cues.en: Which boots up using an American Megatrends BIOS from the mid-90s and an operating system to match:

cues.zh: Windows 95。也不知……为什么。不明白为啥不是 DOS 6.22，这对一台
cues.en: Windows 95. For... some reason. Don’t know why it’s not DOS 6.22, this is a poor choice for a

cues.zh: 386 来说是个糟糕的选择。尤其是这一台：DM&P M6117，一块 40MHz 的嵌入式 386SX，16 位数据总线，
cues.en: 386. Especially this one: a DM&P M6117, which is a 40MHz embedded 386SX with a 16-bit data bus,

cues.zh: 只有 DX 芯片的一半。这类芯片通常见于工业单板计算机，这些 PC 里的许多
cues.en: half that of a DX chip. These are typically found in industrial single board computers, same as many

cues.zh: 其他部件也是如此。它还有 8MB 内存，以及 Chips & Technology
cues.en: other components in these PCs. It also has 8 megabytes of RAM, and Chips & Technology

cues.zh: F65535 显卡、1MB 显存，对 386 来说相当不错了！
cues.en: F65535 graphics with a meg of video memory, pretty good for a 386!

cues.zh: 但其余部分的构建对95来说实在太慢了，这选择怎么看都让人费解。
cues.en: But the rest of the build is simply too slow for 95, it’s a confusing choice all-around.

cues.zh: 当然，你可以随意安装喜欢的东西，或者坚持纯DOS模式。而在DOS下，一切
cues.en: Naturally you can install whatever you like, or stick to pure DOS mode. And in DOS things

cues.zh: 对40MHz的386来说都运行得很好！只不过是没有turbo的版本，所以像Bubble Ghost或
cues.en: work just fine for a 40MHz 386! Albeit one without turbo, so games like Bubble Ghost or

cues.zh: Test Drive III这类为更慢386编写的游戏会跑得太快。除非使用降速软件、禁用
cues.en: Test Drive III coded for a slower 386 will run too fast. Unless using slowdown software, disabling

cues.zh: 缓存之类的。而速度的另一面是，1993年及以后的游戏大多运行得
cues.en: cache or what have you. And on the flipside of speed, games from 1993 and beyond mostly run like

cues.zh: 像蜗牛爬。所以最好挑那个中间甜点区的游戏。像Duke Nukem
cues.en: sludge. So it’s best to choose games from that in-between sweet spot. Titles like Duke Nukem

cues.zh: II和Wolfenstein 3D这样的作品运行良好，对早期90年代的EGA和VGA游戏来说速度绰绰有余。
cues.en: II and Wolfenstein 3D function well, there’s ample speed for early 90s EGA and VGA gaming.

cues.zh: 遗憾的是Hand386不支持Sound Blaster兼容，所以只有AdLib和PC
cues.en: Sad to say the Hand386 lacks Sound Blaster compatibility though, so it’s AdLib and PC

cues.zh: 喇叭。而且扬声器和耳机仍然没有物理音量控制，搞什么
cues.en: speaker only. And there’s still no physical volume controls for the speakers or headphones, what

cues.en: the heck? You can at least add a Sound Blaster using another one of those $20 ISA bus extenders,

cues.zh: 但这些不是16位插槽，所以用它也意味着被限制在8位ISA的能力范围内。
cues.en: but these aren’t 16-bit slots, so using it also means being limited to 8-bit ISA capabilities.

cues.zh: 但没错，真正吸引人的是，你居然能做到这件事，
cues.en: But yeah, it’s the fact that you can do this at all that’s so appealing,

cues.zh: 而不需要像90年代那些可扩展便携设备那样，配一个巨大的扩展坞。
cues.en: without needing a huge docking station as we often did with expandable portables in the 90s.

cues.zh: 这些奇奇怪怪的速卖通便携PC差不多就这些了！天哪，
cues.en: And that’s about it for these funky little Aliexpress portable PCs! And boy,

cues.en: they sure are an odd mixture of skillful engineering, compromised hardware,

cues.zh: 以及可疑软件的奇怪混合体。我觉得很难推荐它们中的任何一款，尤其是在200美元的价格下，
cues.en: and sketchy software being used. I’d find it difficult to recommend either one of them at $200,

cues.zh: 假设它们将来还会再次上架的话。它们适合周末折腾一下，

cues.en: but beyond that? They seem more like a proof of concept for cramming legacy hardware into a small

cues.zh: 而不是本身已经完成的产品。说来也怪，Book8088反而是
cues.en: form factor, rather than finalized products in and of themselves. Weirdly enough the Book8088 is the

cues.zh: 相对更“可用”的系统，因为它的键盘和尺寸。但同时也没那么
cues.en: system that’s more “usable,” so to speak, due to its keyboard and size. While also being less

cues.zh: 实用，因为速度慢、显示差、接口少。而Hand386则更有使用潜力，
cues.en: useful due to its slower speed, bad display, and lack of ports. And the Hand386 has more potential

cues.zh: 因为它更快、I/O更多。但作为便携设备，它的体验也更差。
cues.en: for use, being the faster machine with more I/O. But as a portable, it’s also the worse experience.

cues.zh: 要是能把两者揉在一起，做成一台带翻盖外壳、接口更多的386 PC，

cues.en: Palmtop PCs from the ‘90s. Such as the IBM PC110, exactly the type of thing I’d rather use.

cues.zh: 还能以150到200美元买到，而且你不仅能得到不错的键盘和更多I/O，
cues.en: still be purchased for between $150 to $200, and not only do you get a nice keyboard and more I/O,

cues.en: but also a 75MHz Pentium, 32 megs of RAM, and a 6-inch 4:3 LCD that looks great for its

cues.en: age. Clearly, vintage machines aren’t getting any younger, caps and displays are failing, batteries

cues.zh: 也报废了等等。但如果你的目标是花两百美元拥有一台够用的小型DOS PC呢？
cues.en: are kaput and so on. But if your aim is to have a capable little DOS PC for two hundred bucks?

cues.zh: 90年代的原创作品值得考虑。不过我承认，作为痴迷复古技术的怪人，这些速卖通系统玩起来挺有意思。
cues.en: A 90s original is worth considering. Though I will admit these Aliexpress systems are fun to

cues.zh: 我很喜欢这里的基本概念，把旧
cues.en: experiment with as a retro tech obsessed weirdo. I love the base concept here, repurposing old
